# Babel Romanian 1.2m

Unmodified upstream runtime and sources, distributed alongside the Babel system
in our pinned TeX Live bundle. Copyright 1989–2021 Johannes L. Braams and the
individual authors named in the files. License: LPPL 1.3 or later; the original
copyright, maintenance, and license notices are retained in each source file.

- Package: https://ctan.org/pkg/babel-romanian
- `romanian.ldf`: `tex/generic/babel-romanian/romanian.ldf` from
  https://mirror.ctan.org/systems/texlive/tlnet/archive/babel-romanian.tar.xz
  (archive SHA-256 `589309271e244b99b37facbb5cfc4c75c3de0deed1371cacdd328547e531fcb6`).
- `romanian.dtx`, `romanian.ins`, `README.md`: from
  https://mirrors.ctan.org/macros/latex/contrib/babel-contrib/romanian.zip
  (archive SHA-256 `4cd09ea02a0078aac3ca2c92d9378b5cd93c709c5870e46d96e6389658c8dfd8`).

The `.dtx` and `.ins` files are the corresponding source and generation script
for the `.ldf`. These files now provide source/license provenance for the package-download test
fixture. The application downloads the runtime archive from the configured mirror;
it no longer injects this vendored runtime into projects.
